first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Blue Sky
entities.identification: The blue area above the horizon, lighter near the horizon and partially occluded by tree canopies.

entities.name: Dry Grassland
entities.identification: A large expanse of light yellowish-brown ground, with alternating clumps of short grass, bare soil, and coarse light-and-dark textures.

entities.name: Scattered Trees and Shrubs
entities.identification: Trees and low shrubs scattered across the grassland, including the nearer dark-colored tree on the left and the farther light-colored tree on the right in the final frame.

entities.name: Dirt Road and Linear Track
entities.identification: A broad brown dirt road running through the grassland, with a surface smoother than the surrounding grassland; in the final frame, its near section curves and extends to the right.

entities.name: Curved Ground Mark
entities.identification: Multiple curved, partially nested light-and-dark patterns on the grass-and-soil surface in the foreground during the early segment.

entities.name: Distant Long, Narrow Water Surface
entities.identification: A long, narrow, smooth blue-gray band of water on the far side of the grassland, adjacent to a light-colored shoreline.
